zh.heroLead: 把接待空间、建筑设施与室外环境的维护，安排进实际营业节奏。
zh.localIntro: Frankston 与莫宁顿半岛拥有多种商业物业。Frankston 的工业规划涵盖 Carrum Downs 与 Seaford 等片区，半岛也有旅游与访客服务相关企业。对于餐饮接待场所、工业物业和室外环境，我们会先了解物业地址、营业安排、现场任务及可进入时间，再讨论检查和施工次序。室外工作按实际材料、天气条件和场地情况确认；多处物业则分别列出需求，便于把进场、材料准备与验收责任安排清楚。若存在预约、送货或人员活动限制，也可以在咨询时一并说明。

planning.title: 室外作业条件

faq.question: 可以按餐厅或接待场所的营业时间安排吗？
faq.answer: 可以先沟通营业、预约和可施工时间。我们会根据作业内容说明分区或分阶段方案，具体日期与时间在范围确认后商定。

faq.question: 半岛室外工程会怎样安排时间？
faq.answer: 需要结合具体地址、工作内容和实际天气条件安排。提供照片、材料情况及进入方式，可帮助我们准备检查并说明施工顺序。

faq.question: 可以同时咨询工业物业和商业营业场所吗？
faq.answer: 可以。请分别提供各场地用途、地址和问题清单，我们会按不同现场条件梳理维护范围和安排。

en.h1: Commercial Property Maintenance in Frankston & Mornington Peninsula
en.metaTitle: Commercial Maintenance Frankston & Mornington Peninsula | Ellis
en.metaDescription: Building, roofing, cleaning and grounds maintenance for Frankston and Mornington Peninsula commercial premises. Discuss access, trading hours and site needs.
en.heroLead: Fit building, reception and outdoor maintenance into the way your premises operate.
en.localIntro: Frankston and the Mornington Peninsula contain a range of commercial premises. Frankston’s industrial strategy identifies precincts including Carrum Downs and Seaford, while the Peninsula supports tourism and visitor-related businesses. For hospitality venues, industrial properties and outdoor areas, we begin with the address, trading arrangements, task list and available access before discussing inspection and work sequencing. External tasks are planned around the actual materials, weather conditions and site requirements. If you manage several premises, list each site separately so access contacts, material preparation and handover responsibilities are clear. Share any bookings, delivery times or public activities that affect entry. Specific attendance and project timing are agreed after the location and scope have been reviewed.

scenarios.title: Hospitality and visitor spaces
scenarios.problem: Entrances, amenities and trading spaces need repairs or cleaning around bookings and visitors.
scenarios.approach: Confirm trading arrangements and available work areas before coordinating repairs, cleaning and handover checks.
scenarios.handover: Identify returned areas, remaining tasks and follow-on maintenance recommendations.

scenarios.title: Industrial and storage premises
scenarios.problem: Roof, door or shared-facility issues affect different parts of the premises.
scenarios.approach: Review affected locations, storage areas and access routes to define inspection, repairs and protection.
scenarios.handover: Record completed work and monitoring items by property area.

scenarios.title: Entrances, courtyards and outdoor areas
scenarios.problem: Planting, irrigation, paths and routine cleaning form one shared outdoor environment.
scenarios.approach: Review water arrangements, visitor routes, planting condition and cleaning needs to plan work by zone.
scenarios.handover: Hand over maintained areas and follow-up tasks suitable for a recurring schedule.

planning.title: Trading and bookings
planning.body: Share busy periods, booked events and work windows so staged attendance can be discussed.

planning.title: Address and site preparation
planning.body: For multiple premises, provide each address, contact and photos, together with delivery and entry requirements.

planning.title: Conditions for external work
planning.body: Confirm roof, grounds and other external work sequencing against actual weather, materials and site conditions.

faq.question: Can work be planned around restaurant or visitor-venue trading hours?
faq.answer: Yes. Share trading hours, bookings and available work windows. We discuss separate areas or stages based on the task, with dates and times agreed after the scope is confirmed.

faq.question: How is outdoor work on the Peninsula scheduled?
faq.answer: Scheduling depends on the address, scope and actual weather conditions. Photos, material details and access information help us prepare the inspection and explain the sequence.

faq.question: Can industrial premises and trading venues be included in the same enquiry?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide each property’s use, address and task list. We review the maintenance scope and arrangements against the conditions at each site.
